name: Pexacerfont
summary: Pexacerfont (INN, previously known as BMS-562,086) is a drug developed by Bristol-Myers Squibb which acts as a CRF1 antagonist.

pharmacology.text: Pexacerfont (INN, previously known as BMS-562,086) is a drug developed by Bristol-Myers Squibb which acts as a CRF1 antagonist. Pexacerfont is a recently developed CRF-1 antagonist which was in clinical trials for the treatment of anxiety disorders, and has also been proposed to be useful for the treatment of depression and irritable bowel syndrome.

uses.text: Pexacerfont (INN, previously known as BMS-562,086) is a drug developed by Bristol-Myers Squibb which acts as a CRF1 antagonist. Pexacerfont is a recently developed CRF-1 antagonist which was in clinical trials for the treatment of anxiety disorders, and has also been proposed to be useful for the treatment of depression and irritable bowel syndrome.

fact.en: It blocks the CRF1 receptor, the first step in the body's stress hormone chain that ends in cortisol, which made it an appealing but ultimately unsuccessful idea for treating anxiety.
fact.zh: 它阻斷 CRF1 受體，這是人體壓力荷爾蒙連鎖反應的第一步，最終導向皮質醇。這個構想對治療焦慮很有吸引力，但最終未能成功。
fact.zhHans: 它阻断 CRF1 受体，这是人体压力荷尔蒙连锁反应的第一步，最终导向皮质醇。这个构想对治疗焦虑很有吸引力，但最终未能成功。
